slides.headline: Meta launches *Muse Wonder*, its first frontier AI model

slides.heading: Meta's *first frontier* models
paras: Meta released two models on Monday: Muse Wonder and the more powerful Muse Wonder Full. They come from Meta Superintelligence Labs and build on Muse Spark.
On Meta's own tests, the models score close to the top models from OpenAI and Anthropic in reasoning, writing and coding. These are Meta's own results.

slides.heading: Memory, focus and a *$4* price
paras: Meta says Active Memory carries context across conversations. Active Focus keeps the model on a goal when tasks get hard, and it can check in before important actions.
Muse Wonder is available now through the Meta Model API for $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens. Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers.

paras.t: Meta says Muse Wonder will soon power its Muse app.

slides.hook: Meta says it has caught up with OpenAI and Anthropic. Follow to see if the benchmarks hold up.
